lanes.summary: The diff completely fulfills the acceptance criteria. It introduces the `reachability_gate` and `selected_dot_kernel` to verify that no quantized dot product falls back to scalar when a SIMD kernel is available on the host, except for explicitly declared gaps (Q5_K for all architectures, Q4_K×f32 for aarch64). The NEON kernels for Q4_K×Q8_K and Q6_K×f32 are properly implemented, bitwise-checked against the scalar kernel (Q4_K) and precision-checked against the f64 reference (Q6_K). The VNNI vs lean AVX2 benchmark in slice 1 is included as an ignored test, and the dispatch logic in `fused_q4k_q8k_parallel_matvec_into` correctly remains unchanged as requested, properly documented by comments. No extraneous changes or forbidden modifications were detected.

Review of PMAT-2880 diff (2718c5214...HEAD) against all acceptance criteria, receipt claims, and ticket constraints. All 4 slices are verified: (1) Slice 1 bench vnni_reach_bench confirms AVX2 dispatch retains precedence over slower VNNI 4-row on Zen 4; (2) Slice 2 aarch64 NEON Q4_K×Q8_K dot in fused_q4k_q8k_dot_neon achieves exact bitwise parity with scalar reference; (3) Slice 3 aarch64 NEON Q6_K×f32 dot in fused_q6k_dot_neon achieves accuracy within 1e-5·Σ|w·a| of f64 reference; (4) Slice 4 reachability gate in kernel_path.rs correctly enforces that no quantized dot runs scalar on a SIMD host unless explicitly declared in KNOWN_SCALAR_GAPS, and fails if a declared gap closes. No tests assert the opposite, no gates are weakened, all receipt claims are backed by the diff, and no out-of-scope changes exist. Verdict: PASS.

Diff 2718c5214...HEAD strictly satisfies all acceptance criteria of PMAT-2880 across Slices 1–4 without scope creep or weakened gates:
- Slice 1: Benchmarked AVX-512 VNNI 4-row vs lean AVX2 on Zen 4 (ignored test vnni_reach_bench in vnni_reach_bench_tests.rs); dispatch order in q5k_q6k_matvec.rs preserved with measured rationale.
- Slice 2: Implemented aarch64 NEON Q4_K×Q8_K dot in q4k_q8k_dot_neon.rs, wired into fused_q4k_q8k_dot_simd; verified bitwise identical to scalar via neon_matches_scalar_bitwise.
- Slice 3: Implemented aarch64 NEON Q6_K×f32 dot in q6k_dot_neon.rs, wired into fused_q6k_dot_simd; verified against f64 reference within 1e-5·Σ|w·a| tolerance via q6k_neon_matches_f64_reference.
- Slice 4: Added per-ISA reachability gate and selected_dot_kernel in kernel_path.rs. All dispatchers match on selected_dot_kernel; reachability_gate fails on undeclared scalar paths or closed declared gaps.
- Declared gaps in KNOWN_SCALAR_GAPS are properly scoped and owned by #2880.
